import numpy as np

# Extract the relevant columns for analysis
education_expenditure = adjusted_savings_df.filter(regex='YR').values
school_primary_enrollment = school_primary_df.filter(regex='YR').values
school_secondary_enrollment = school_secondary_df.filter(regex='YR').values

# Calculate the correlation between education expenditure and school enrollment
correlation_primary = np.corrcoef(education_expenditure, school_primary_enrollment)[0, 1]
correlation_secondary = np.corrcoef(education_expenditure, school_secondary_enrollment)[0, 1]
correlation_primary, correlation_secondary

# Extract the relevant columns for economic output
gni_per_capita = gni_df.filter(regex='YR').values
exports_growth = exports_df.filter(regex='YR').values

# Calculate the correlation between education expenditure and economic output
correlation_gni = np.corrcoef(education_expenditure, gni_per_capita)[0, 1]
correlation_exports = np.corrcoef(education_expenditure, exports_growth)[0, 1]
correlation_gni, correlation_exports

from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression

# Prepare the data for regression
X = education_expenditure
y_gni = gni_per_capita
y_exports = exports_growth

# Create a linear regression model for GNI per capita
model_gni = LinearRegression()
model_gni.fit(X.reshape(-1, 1), y_gni)
coefficient_gni = model_gni.coef_[0]

# Create a linear regression model for exports of goods and services
model_exports = LinearRegression()
model_exports.fit(X.reshape(-1, 1), y_exports)
coefficient_exports = model_exports.coef_[0]

coefficient_gni, coefficient_exports
